name: Li Andersson - Proposition de la Commission au Conseil
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council decision on the guidelines for the employment policies of the Member States
part_text:
The European Parliament has looked at the European Commission's proposal for guidelines on employment policies in the member states. It approves the proposal without asking for any changes. The guidelines themselves are not included in this document, so it does not say what they contain. Parliament also asks the Council to tell it if the Council plans to change the text, and to consult Parliament again if it makes substantial changes.

- No changes are made: Parliament simply approves the Commission's proposal as it stands.
- It affects the Council and the Commission, which receive Parliament's position.
- Next, the Council decides whether to adopt the proposal or change it.
